items.title: Night Wrap: Tuesday, October 27
items.html:
The week closed with 93 games, 653 goals and 15 overtimes. Calgary scored twenty goals in two games. Newfoundland, you have our sympathies.

The headline: l danks l, ten-point man

l danks l (Calgary) hung 7 goals and 3 assists on Ottawa in a 10-2 win (918200). That came right after a 3G 4A night in a 10-0 shutout of London (918170). For the night: 12G 9A, 21 points, +16, the biggest night in the league. Before puck drop, LG's own lineup listing had him at 0-6-6 for the season.

Twelve on the sheet

Victoria beat Newfoundland 15-2 (918197). NitroQc x 10 had 3G 9A, 12 points with the GWG, and lightoutshooter scored seven. Earlier, Everett had put 12 on Newfoundland (918155), with Redemption16676 going 5G 5A. That's 27 goals against the Regiment in two games.

Blowout board

  • Victoria 15, Newfoundland 2 (918197)
  • Everett 12, Newfoundland 2 (918155)
  • Calgary 10, London 0 (918170)
  • Barrie 9, Sherbrooke 1 (918176). TexroFN had 4G 5A.
  • Calgary 10, Ottawa 2 (918200)
  • Guelph 9, Cape Breton 2 (918201)

OT club (15)

  • Kadokincaid (London): hat trick, finished off with the OT winner in a 4-3 win over Brampton (918206). That's the same night London got shut out 10-0.
  • Prince George outlasted Peterborough 7-6 in OT (918196). xZainer89 had 5G 2A, and ItzAverage- had 2G 3A with the GWG.
  • lumck17 (Moncton) had 1G 4A with the GWG in a 6-5 OT win over Calgary. ClxpNHL scored five goals.
  • Brantford beat Seattle 5-4 (KeenanTroy, 2G 2A, GWG), and Penticton beat Niagara 5-4 (delucadx, GWG).

Brick walls

Doc_Plonker made 22 saves to steal a 1-0 win for Victoriaville over Penticton (918130), and PeakzReturn lost that duel with 13 saves on 14. More shutouts went to Bumpregion (Spokane, 21 saves), aidan_ge. (Ottawa, 21), YanSavage5293 (Blainville-Boisbriand, 17), spacejay7 (Erie, 15), jasonx1755 (Owen Sound, two shutouts), and XxPASTRNAK88 for Calgary.

Asterisks

Three Kamloops games (918144, 918160, 918195) have final scores but no player lines. They look like forfeits. Five games have period goals that don't add up to the final score (per capture.json).

items.title: Night Wrap: Monday, October 26
items.html:
Monday brought 93 games, 645 goals, 15 overtimes and 12 lag-outs. The goalies showed up too, and so did one Medicine Hat line.

Medicine Hat's twin towers

The Tigers flattened Halifax 12-1 (918049). Borzy0430 went 5G 5A and chasepidgeon. went 4G 6A: ten points apiece, both +11. BDANG made 19 saves on 20 to keep it from getting silly the other way. Over three games each of them finished with 17 points. Things swung back later, though: Drummondville handed Medicine Hat a 9-3 loss (918068), led by Local Booz with 6G 3A.

Blowout board

  • Medicine Hat 12, Halifax 1 (918049)
  • Chicoutimi 9, Wenatchee 1 (918095). IIx OMARK xII had 2G 6A.
  • Kitchener 7, Regina 0 (918063). RFVoltage shut them out on 19 saves.
  • Moncton 9, Seattle 2 (918056). SlipperyPuppy3 had 3G 5A.
  • Barrie 10, Victoria 3 (918080). oettysznn had 4G 4A.
  • Drummondville 9, Medicine Hat 3 (918068)

Goalie night

  • rutters717 (Rouyn-Noranda) posted two shutouts in one night: 11 saves in a 2-0 win at Seattle, then 23 saves in a 1-0 OT win over Ottawa (918092). xX Z3NO Xx stopped 19 of 20 at the other end and still lost. Duggan4204 got the only goal, in overtime.
  • I Kolosov I (Penticton) stopped 25 of 25 in a 4-0 win over Cape Breton (918065).
  • More clean sheets: Lunaetiik (Rimouski), KOLLER (Lethbridge), BuzzFerda69 (Flint), xPirateqc (Gatineau), Rshawzie (Prince George), Slavo_i24i (Sarnia, 17 saves).

OT roll call (15)

North Bay beat Edmonton 5-4 behind LIowkey's 2G 3A and the GWG. Kingston won twice in OT: 5-4 over Calgary (ROMAN95 hat trick and the GWG) and 2-1 at Gatineau (Lemmiwinks17). Windsor went 2-1 in OT. Charlottetown beat Brandon 4-3 (TheDacAttac, 2G 2A) and beat Windsor 2-1. Moncton survived Owen Sound 5-4.

Calgary corner

Calgary bounced back with a 2-0-1 night: 3-1 at Shawinigan, a 5-4 OT loss in Kingston, and a 4-1 win over Sudbury that had to be finished after a lag-out. offtheyrk scored two hat tricks.

items.title: Night Wrap: Sunday, October 25
items.html:
Ninety-three games. 684 goals. Fifteen went past regulation. Sunday night came out swinging and never let up, so buckle in.

The headliner: ChaseWx goes nuclear

Brampton put a 12-2 beating on Shawinigan (917955), and ChaseWx was everywhere. Six goals, four assists, ten points, +9, on 12 shots out of 25 attempts. Nickify rode shotgun with 3G 6A. Shawinigan's goalie Lett m3 c00k faced 34 shots. Some nights you're the hammer, and Sunday Brampton was the whole toolbox.

Eight. Goals.

Cape Breton beat Chilliwack 10-7 (917932). MeNoThatGood scored eight goals, and xGrogu- set the table with nine assists. Then MeNoThatGood came back in the second game and buried four more, including the game-winner, in a 5-4 OT win over Seattle (917963). That's 14 goals on the night. Somebody check the twine.

Blowout board

  • Brampton 12, Shawinigan 2 (917955)
  • Guelph 9, Everett 1 (917948)
  • Victoria 8, Saint John 1 (917935)
  • Charlottetown 7, Regina 1 (917940)
  • Saginaw 8, Calgary 2 (917941)
  • Sault Ste. Marie 8, Val-d'Or 2 (918019)

Bonus hockey: 15 OT finals

Drummondville over Red Deer 4-3, with Bluda37 hitting the hat trick and taking the GWG. Erie over Halifax 3-2 (gavin6948, 2G and the GWG). Prince Albert over Baie-Comeau 4-3, where CaptainFrat591 put up 1G 3A with the winner. Kamloops traded OT results all night: they lost to Owen Sound 3-2, lost to Sherbrooke 4-3, and beat London 3-2 (Stafano99 got the GWG). Kitchener needed OT to squeeze past Rouyn-Noranda 2-1 (917962).

Three-game warriors

  • MJ l19l (Sault Ste. Marie): 9G 9A, 18 points, +12 over three games
  • .lwindzy (SSM): 17 points, +12. The Greyhounds' top line ate well.
  • MeNoThatGood (Cape Breton): 14G 3A
  • Brandflakes29 (North Bay): 10G 6A
  • Thomas l18l (Guelph): 15 points, +13

Brick wall

Strachan73 stopped all 16 shots in Flint's shutout of Regina (917997), and AcidChief397 answered with 22 saves on 23 at the other end. Clean sheets also went to dunzy9510 (Spokane, 14 saves), imrehabilitated (Saskatoon), PeakzReturn (Penticton), DUCAS I8I (Moncton) and nothargi4200 (Victoria).

Calgary corner

It was a rough Sunday in Cowtown. The Hitmen lost 8-2 at Saginaw (a lag-out game), fell 3-2 in OT to Windsor (DeaconDish21 got the GWG), and dropped a 5-3 decision to Gatineau. That's 0-2-1, with Monday waiting.

items.title: Week 5 features: Player of the Week, Heat Check and more
items.html:
Player of the Week: l danks l, Calgary Hitmen (RW)

  • Week line: 3 GP, 12G 9A, 21 PTS, +16 (all on Tue Oct 27). That's the top point total of the week. Runner-up: MJ l19l (SSM), 18 PTS on Sun.
  • Card brief: a "Player of the Week" foil banner across the top, a Hitmen black/red/gold frame, "21" as a big watermark, and a ribbon reading "7-goal game · Oct 27 vs Ottawa." Generic silhouette, no likeness.

Goalie of the Week: spacejay7, Erie Otters

  • 6 GP: 93 saves on 103 shots (.903), 1 shutout. That's the best save % among goalies with 6 GP and 90+ shots, and Erie went 8-0-1, the week's best record.
  • Also considered: PeakzReturn (Penticton), 81/91 (.890) with 2 shutouts. rutters717 (Rouyn-Noranda), 97/115 (.843) with 2 shutouts, both on Monday.

Heat Check

  • 🔥 Erie Otters: 8-0-1, unbeaten in regulation all week.
  • 🔥 Guelph Storm: 7-1-1, +30 goal differential.
  • 🔥 Calgary's Tuesday unit: 20-2 over its last two games.
  • 🔥 MJ l19l / .lwindzy (SSM): 18 and 17 points on Sunday.
  • 🧊 Newfoundland Regiment: 1-8, -38. Allowed 27 in two Tuesday games.
  • 🧊 Regina Pats: 1-8, 17 goals all week.
  • 🧊 Sherbrooke Phoenix: 3-6, -22. (Team-level cold list only. We don't single out players for slumps.)

Rink Rat Rumours (real moves only)

  • Trades: none on file. data/transactions/lgchl-s55.json is still awaiting_data, with no trades recorded through Oct 24.
  • Calgary's revolving door: the Hitmen dressed three different five-skater groups on three nights. Sunday's group was Gullyrr, WhiteoutI8I, XFITSKY, Call1-800gambler and thenny32. Monday's was offtheyrk, SmokoLi, IIII metro, WhyKayWins and matt_0_5. Tuesday's was l danks l, gtcoop73, l Setty l, Koldex Bands and imona_plain. Tuesday's group went 2-0-1.
  • Surprise netminder: fred_7517, listed by LG as an RW, played goal at Moncton (17 saves on 23 shots).
  • Kamloops: three Oct 27 games went final with no lines recorded. They look like forfeits, so we're watching that one.

Locker Room Legends: offtheyrk, Calgary Hitmen (LW)

On Monday he scored two hat tricks and had 11 points in three games, including all three goals and the GWG at Shawinigan. LG's Tuesday lineup listing shows him at 27-25-52 for S55, the most points among the Hitmen listed. The spotlight passed to l danks l the next night, but Monday was offtheyrk's.

Rivalry Week candidate: Calgary Hitmen vs Moncton Wildcats

Moncton went 8-1 this week, and one of those wins was a 6-5 OT shootout-style track meet against Calgary (918122): ClxpNHL scored 5, and lumck17 won it. Calgary came out of that loss with 20 goals in its next two games. That's a rematch worth circling.

There isn't enough data for true power rankings: there's no standings data, and only 9 games of results for the week. Here's a form ranking of Week 5 only (points from W×2 + OTL, then goal differential): 1. Erie Otters, 8-0-1 (+19), 17 pts 2. Barrie Colts, 8-1 (+28), 16 3. Spokane Chiefs, 8-1 (+23), 16 4. Penticton Vees, 7-2 (+9), 14 10. Prince George Cougars, 7-2 (+8), 14

items.title: The Week That Was: Week 5 in the LGCHL
items.html:
By the numbers

  • 279 games, 1,982 goals, 45 overtime finals.
  • Best week: Erie went 8-0-1 (+19). Barrie, Spokane, Rimouski and Moncton each went 8-1. Guelph went 7-1-1 with the league's best goal differential (+30).
  • Toughest week: Newfoundland, Regina and Portland each went 1-8. Newfoundland allowed 74 goals.

Storylines

  1. The 21-point night. On Tuesday l danks l (Calgary) went 12G 9A, including 7G 3A in one game against Ottawa. Nobody in the league had a bigger night.
  2. Goal-scoring heroics. MeNoThatGood scored 14 goals for Cape Breton on Sunday, 8 of them in one game. ChaseWx (Brampton) and Borzy0430 (Medicine Hat) each had 10-point games.
  3. Goalie double-ups. rutters717 (Rouyn-Noranda, Mon) and jasonx1755 (Owen Sound, Tue) each posted two shutouts in one night.
  4. Overtime everywhere. Exactly 15 of the 93 games went past regulation on every night of the week.

Hitmen week

  • Sun: 0-2-1 (L 2-8 at Saginaw, OTL 2-3 vs Windsor, L 3-5 vs Gatineau)
  • Mon: 2-0-1 (W 3-1 at Shawinigan, OTL 4-5 at Kingston, W 4-1 vs Sudbury). offtheyrk scored two hat tricks.
  • Tue: 2-0-1 (OTL 5-6 at Moncton, W 10-0 vs London, W 10-2 vs Ottawa). l danks l had 21 points.
  • Week: 4-2-3, 43 GF and 31 GA. The record moved from 18-17-4 to 22-19-7. (That's back-calculated from scores and the 20-19-6 LG printed after game 918111. LG's own record field is inconsistent on Oct 27.)

Standings notes

There's no standings data in the repo: no standings/ drop for Week 5, so I can't make conference or division claims. Week-only form is above.

Data notes

Three Kamloops games on Oct 27 look like forfeits (scores, no lines). Five Oct 27 games have period goals that don't sum to the final. Oct 27 has no game JSON or team stats.

items.title: Night Wrap: Tuesday, October 20
items.html:
124 games on the board and 25 of them went to overtime. Prince George's Nxva_Deleted scored 12 goals, the Cougars jumped four spots in the WHL West, and seven clubs went 4-0.

The headline: twelve for Nxva_Deleted

Nxva_Deleted (Prince George Cougars) had 12 goals and 6 assists, 18 points in four games, including 7 goals and 4 assists in a 13-4 win at Portland. IBiggy OtisI matched him with 18 points (4 G, 14 A), 11 of them in that same game. Prince George went 4-0 (3-1 vs Rimouski, 13-4 at Portland, 5-0 vs Owen Sound, 2-1 vs Shawinigan), outscored opponents 23-6, has won five straight and climbed from 7th to 3rd in the WHL West with 44 points.

Four for four

  • Prince George Cougars: 23-6 on the night, five straight wins.
  • Gatineau Olympiques have won seven straight, the longest active streak in the league. Two of tonight's wins came in overtime (4-3 vs Brantford, 3-2 vs Spokane). Baw x 22 had 8 goals.
  • Oshawa Generals have won six straight. Philartmony had 15 points (5 G, 10 A) and kworker84 7 goals.
  • London Knights (four straight): Kadokincaid 17 points, iSHOOTSfromDEEPS 15.

items.title: Night Wrap: Monday, October 19
items.html:
Week 4 rolled on with 124 finals, 812 goals and 18 shutouts. Quebec's Bwxxd scored 16 goals, Vancouver pulled off the shock of the night, and four clubs went 4-0.

Game of the night: Vancouver 2, Drummondville 0

The Vancouver Giants came in 58th in the EliteChel power index; the Drummondville Voltigeurs came in 3rd. Vancouver won 2-0, a shutout and one of the three biggest upset gaps on the night. Vancouver finished 2-2 (also winning 7-4 at Guelph) and sits 12-23-0 with 24 points. Drummondville went 1-2-1 and is 23-7-5 with 51 points.

The headline: sixteen for Bwxxd

Bwxxd (Quebec Remparts) had 16 goals and 12 assists, 28 points in four games, which is most of his 31 points this season (17 G, 14 A in 7 GP). Teammate Max1973-2002 added 9 goals and 21 points. Quebec went 3-1, scoring 33 goals, including a 16-1 win over Niagara; the only loss was 5-4 at Prince Albert.

Four for four

  • Spokane Chiefs went 4-0 and have won six straight, climbing from 12th to 8th. They lead the WHL West with 49 points. Perkins1225 had 8 goals and 15 points, and the night opened with a 4-0 shutout at Peterborough.
  • Sault Ste. Marie Greyhounds went 4-0 (four straight) with two shutouts, 1-0 over Seattle and 2-0 at Edmonton, and made the night's biggest climb, from 25th to 13th.
  • Owen Sound Attack went 4-0 (four straight): 5-1 at Gatineau, a 3-0 shutout of Lethbridge, 3-2 over WHL East leader Prince Albert and 6-2 at Moose Jaw.
  • Calgary Hitmen went 4-0 and have won five straight: 3-2 in overtime over OHL West leader Sarnia, a 3-0 shutout of Niagara, 8-3 at Seattle and 7-3 at Val-d'Or. IIII metro had 6 goals and 9 assists.

Upset Alerts

Forty games met the upset rule (a winner 15 or more spots lower in the pre-night power index). items.title: Week 4 features: three nights, three turnarounds
items.html:
1. Gatineau: from five straight losses to seven straight wins

On Sunday the Gatineau Olympiques went 0-4: 1-0 to Medicine Hat, 3-2 to Penticton, 3-0 to Kitchener and 6-0 to Wenatchee. Then they opened Monday with a 5-1 loss to Owen Sound. Five straight losses, and 26 points after Sunday.

They haven't lost since. Gatineau closed Monday with three one-goal wins (4-3 over Victoria, 4-3 over North Bay, 2-1 over Sudbury) and swept Tuesday: 3-0 over Ottawa, 4-3 in overtime over Brantford, 3-2 in overtime over WHL West leader Spokane, and 5-3 over Seattle. That's seven straight, the longest active streak in the league. Gatineau has 40 points (19-18), 7th in the QMJHL West.

Tuesday's names: Baw x 22 with 8 goals and 10 points, and xPirateqc in goal, 51 saves on 59 shots, 4-0, with the shutout of Ottawa.

2. Oshawa wins six straight after six without a win

The Oshawa Generals didn't win on Sunday (0-3-1, including a 7-0 loss to Victoriaville) and lost their first two Monday games, to Regina 2-1 and Sherbrooke 4-1. That was six games without a win.

Then: 1-0 over Medicine Hat and 4-1 over Saskatoon to finish Monday, and a Tuesday sweep: 3-2 in overtime over Edmonton, 5-2 over Halifax, 6-5 over Seattle and 5-3 over Saint John. Six straight, and 12 points in two nights (from 20 to 32). On Tuesday Philartmony had 15 points (5 G, 10 A) and kworker84 14 (7 G, 7 A). Oshawa is still 10th in the OHL East at 14-21, so the climb is just getting started.

3. Prince George's climb

The Prince George Cougars went 1-3 on Sunday and 2-2 on Monday and were 7th in the WHL West with 36 points. Tuesday they went 4-0, outscored opponents 23-6, and finished the night 3rd with 44 points, five straight wins in all. The wins: 3-1 over Rimouski, 13-4 at Portland, 5-0 over Owen Sound and 2-1 over Shawinigan. Rshawzie stopped 61 of 67 shots on the night (.910).

Player spotlight: Nxva_Deleted, Prince George Cougars

Nobody had a bigger Tuesday. Nxva_Deleted scored 12 goals and added 6 assists, 18 points in four games:

Game Result G A

at Portland W 13-4 7 4

The Portland game was an 11-point night: seven goals and four assists in a 13-4 win, with teammate IBiggy OtisI adding 11 points of his own (3 G, 8 A). Nxva_Deleted followed it with a hat trick in the shutout of Owen Sound.

On the season he has 20 goals, 18 assists and 38 points in 13 games, so 12 of his 20 goals came on Tuesday. Prince George won all four games he played and climbed from 7th to 3rd in the WHL West.

items.title: The Week That Was: Week 4 in the LGCHL
items.html:
Three nights, 372 games, an eight-goal game in Quebec, a seven-game turnaround in Gatineau and a new contender for the top spot in the WHL East. Here are the games that mattered most, night by night.

Correction: three of Quebec's Sunday home games (vs Sault Ste. Marie, Kingston and Erie) and Monday's Charlottetown at Penticton game are now forfeits, credited 1-0 to the visiting team with stats wiped. Everything below reflects the official results as they stand.

Sunday, October 18

Brantford starts a ten-game run. The Bulldogs went 4-0, beginning with a 7-3 win over Calgary and finishing 6-5 over Regina. McSwaggerx92 had 22 points (8 G, 14 A) across the four games, with xBPx 91 (17 points) and OhhTor (15) right behind. That made it eight straight, and Brantford won two more on Monday before a 5-4 overtime loss to Moose Jaw ended the streak at ten.

Rimouski 7, Prince Albert 3. The Oceanic swept the night (also 4-1 over Barrie, 8-1 at Lethbridge and 4-3 over Saginaw), and bilodxau scored five in the win over the WHL East leaders, 12 on the night. breault szn added 19 points. bilodxau leads the LGCHL with 77 points and 46 goals.

Medicine Hat's 9-3 win at Owen Sound. MrReSniper had four goals and four assists. Bybdouce scored 12 goals in the three Tigers games that were played (the fourth was a credited 1-0 result at Gatineau).

Lethbridge 3, Sarnia 2. xI Eris Ix stopped 34 of 36 shots and XxHERCULExX x66 scored twice, including the winner, against the OHL West leaders.

Big individual nights. Txyylor scored 13 goals for Ottawa, six of them in a 12-5 win over Newfoundland. LtsYoungBoog had seven in Sherbrooke's 13-3 win over Ottawa, xzghost_official had seven in Edmonton's 10-2 win over Erie, and right winger Super__Goalie_ had four goals and four assists in Red Deer's 10-1 win at Erie.

Also: Regina beat Brampton 4-1 behind an EK Metal hat trick and 22 saves from Dede_I29I, and dunzy9510 won three games for Spokane, including a 13-save shutout of Sault Ste. Marie. Gatineau went 0-4, which turned out to be the start of a very different story.

Monday, October 19

Quebec 16, Niagara 1. Bwxxd had eight goals and five assists in this one, and 16 goals, 12 assists and 28 points across Quebec's four games, most of his season total (31 points in seven games after Monday). Teammate Max1973-2002 had 21 points, eight of them in the Niagara game.

Vancouver 2, Drummondville 0. The game of the night: the Giants, now 11th in the WHL West, shut out one of the league's top teams. zackbrown17 made 20 saves and xSullylab- scored the winner.

Four for four. Spokane (six straight at that point; Perkins1225 8 G, 15 points), Sault Ste. Marie (two shutouts, 1-0 over Seattle and 2-0 at Edmonton, then 5-4 over Medicine Hat), Owen Sound (including 3-2 over Prince Albert) and Calgary all swept the night.

Oshawa 1, Medicine Hat 0. The win that turned Oshawa's week around. l9lPLAYMAKERl9l made 82 saves on 89 shots (.921) across four games. Everett also beat Sarnia 2-1 and Baie-Comeau beat Sudbury 4-2.

Also: peteypipes00500 had 11 goals and 20 points for Erie, DirtyDangler82 had 15 points for Brantford, and Victoria posted two shutouts plus an 8-2 win over Drummondville.

Tuesday, October 20

Prince George 13, Portland 4. Nxva_Deleted had seven goals and four assists, then a hat trick in a 5-0 shutout of Owen Sound: 12 goals and 18 points on the night, 12 of his 20 goals this season. IBiggy OtisI added 14 assists. Prince George went 4-0, outscored opponents 23-6 and jumped from seventh to third in the WHL West. Rshawzie stopped 61 of 67 shots and won all four.

Gatineau 3, Spokane 2 (OT). The Olympiques lost five straight to open the week, then won seven straight, the longest active streak in the league. Tuesday's sweep included two overtime wins (4-3 over Brantford, 3-2 over WHL West leader Spokane). Baw x 22 scored eight goals and xPirateqc stopped 51 of 59 with a shutout of Ottawa.

Oshawa's six straight. After six games without a win, the Generals swept Tuesday. Philartmony had 15 points (5 G, 10 A) and kworker84 scored seven. They're still 10th in the OHL East, with ground to make up.

Barrie 10, Victoria 0. TexroFN had five goals and three assists, and Fil x 8 posted two shutouts on the night. Victoria went 0-4, was outscored 25-4 and fell from second to fifth in the WHL West.

Also: Sudbury went 4-0 and allowed three goals in four games, and leads the OHL East with 56 points. Burning Wolves (Moncton) and Kadokincaid (London) had 17 points each, and London has won four straight. In Saginaw, vlexx21 stopped 63 of 70 and shares the league lead in save percentage (.869, 8+ GP) with Sherbrooke's zombi3_4_lif3. Twenty-five of the night's 124 games went to overtime.

Calgary Hitmen: 7-4-1 on the week

Calgary lost its first three on Sunday (7-3 at Brantford, 5-3 to Chicoutimi, 3-2 at Barrie), then beat Saint John 6-5 in overtime behind four goals from gtcoop73 (7 G, 4 A on the night). offtheyrk had 12 points and SmokoLi eight. Monday was a 4-0 sweep (3-2 OT over Sarnia, 3-0 over Niagara, 7-3 at Val-d'Or, 8-3 at Seattle) with IIII metro at 15 points (6 G, 9 A), WhiteoutI8I with nine goals and XxPASTRNAK88 winning all four. Tuesday went 2-1-1: the five-game streak ended 3-2 in overtime at Baie-Comeau, Kudolken made 31 saves for a shutout at Brandon (89 of 97 on the night, .918), Calgary beat Flint 4-3 and lost 2-1 at North Bay. geocustom had nine points. Calgary has 40 points, eighth in the WHL East and three back of the 43-point group of Chilliwack, Red Deer and Swift Current.

Three stars of the week

  1. Bwxxd, Quebec Remparts: 16 G, 12 A, 28 PTS (8 goals vs Niagara)
  2. McSwaggerx92, Brantford Bulldogs: 8 G, 14 A, 22 PTS, part of a ten-game win streak
  3. Nxva_Deleted, Prince George Cougars: 12 G, 6 A, 18 PTS, team up from 7th to 3rd

Goalie of the week: l9lPLAYMAKERl9l, Oshawa Generals: 82 saves on 89 shots (.921), including the 1-0 win over Medicine Hat that started a six-game streak.

Power rankings (top five)

  1. Prince Albert Raiders (no change): 61 points, +70, 7-4-1 this week
  2. Medicine Hat Tigers (up from 5): 9-3 this week, 52-28, +70 on the season
  3. Spokane Chiefs (new): 9-2-1, lead the WHL West with 54
  4. Barrie Colts (down from 3): 8-2-2, +64
  5. Sudbury Wolves (new): 9-2-1, lead the OHL East with 56

Dropped out: Drummondville (2nd to 11th) and Sherbrooke (4th to 9th).
